title: Spatial4j closes a MultiPoint before writing sibling values
summary: Serializing a one-element MultiPoint list threw JsonGenerationException on the parent. The merge returned the expected array containing [[100,100]]. Both geometry orders survived the merge with their numeric coordinates, and the enclosing map retained the trailing sibling value 17.

change.description: The serializer closes a MultiPoint before returning to its enclosing object or array.

notes: Each successful write is parsed by a fresh mapper without the geometry module. The observation preserves all fields and array positions while normalizing equivalent numeric spellings.
